agreement_rate.up: the drafts agreed with each other ({v:.2f} of the cohort)
agreement_rate.down: the drafts disagreed with each other (agreement {v:.2f})

lp_min.up: no token was a low-confidence guess
lp_min.down: at least one token was a low-confidence guess

lp_mean.up: the model was confident on average
lp_mean.down: the model was unsure on average

n_ops.down: a larger patch with more edits

writes_only_rule_fields_frac.up: the patch only edits fields the rule reads
writes_only_rule_fields_frac.down: the patch edits fields the rule does not read

uses_placeholder.up: the patch uses the internal CIDR placeholder
uses_placeholder.down: the patch does not use the internal CIDR placeholder

greedy_is_modal.up: the first draft is also the most common draft
greedy_is_modal.down: the first draft is not the most common draft
